⌈The function CorTst_GetFgndSignature shall return Core Test result signature
type as Core Test result of the last completed test run in foreground mode.⌋
[SWS_CorTst_00122] ⌈The function CorTst_GetFgndSignature shall return value
zero per default as signature until a first initial Core Test run has successfully been
executed which will provide first valid signature representation.⌋
